title: First-trimester AI and machine-learning pre-eclampsia model validated in an Asian cohort
summary: In a secondary analysis of a multicenter prospective cohort of 10 935 pregnancies, a first-trimester AI+ML model for preterm pre-eclampsia was applied. Before adjustment for biochemical analyzers it was lower than the FMF competing-risk model (preterm AUC 0.82 vs 0.86, P = 0.019). After adjustment for the analyzers the authors report comparable performance.
ai_technology: Previously developed AI and machine-learning first-trimester pre-eclampsia prediction model
organization: Chinese University of Hong Kong; Prince of Wales Hospital

evidence.tested: External validation of an existing model in a prospective cohort.
evidence.unknown: Model comparable to, not better than, the FMF model; existing model evaluated; full text not reviewed.
